answer: Spawning fake identities costs real energy and capital, making attacks expensive. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work plus stake: each new agent must burn compute to mine a registration token, then lock a bond that slashes on collusion. Like carving timber from a living vine, each identity requires genuine labor; a lantern marks verified agents while shadow clones stay dark and unrewarded. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
